en: Color postcard showing a large outdoor thermal pool complex crowded with bathers, terraced sunbathing areas and a modern multi‑story hotel surrounded by forest. The back has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp (POSTA ROMANA), and postal cancellations from Băile Felix and București dated June 1982. Printed caption credits the image to the Băile Felix spa near Oradea.
